title: Recent advances in noble-metal-free bifunctional oxygen electrode catalysts
content:
Energy Adv., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4YA00551A, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hengqi Liu, Rui Xiong, Shengyu Ma, Ran Wang, Zhiguo Liu, Tai Yao, Bo Song
This article reviews advancements in non-precious metal bifunctional oxygen electrocatalysts, focusing on the pros and cons of carbon materials, transition metal compounds, composites, active site density, and design principles.
